commit_date: 2026-10 (HEAD master pinné via git ls-remote https://github.com/koel/koel HEAD — git describe latest-56-g72ab1e8d)
framework: Laravel 12/13 (PHP 8.3-cli) + Vue 3.5 + Tailwind 4 + vite-plus/rolldown -> public/build + SQLite (sqlite-persistent) — première stack Laravel/Vue de la boucle ; SPA hash-router /#/…
served_source: Clone @SHA + build vite local obligatoire : les images koel officielles servent un bundle pré-construit impossible à patcher — écart image/SHA documenté. Runtime = Dockerfile maison koel49-runtime (php:8.3-cli + extensions) montant le clone bind /koel + /media ; `php artisan serve :8000` -> hôte :9049.

boot.deps: docker image koel49-php (~/work/koel49-runtime/Dockerfile : php:8.3-cli + gd/exif/fileinfo/pdo_sqlite/mbstring/zip/curl/bcmath/intl/xsl/sockets/pcntl + composer:2) + node via nvm (outillage audit + pnpm build)
boot.build_frontend: cd ~/work/koel49 && export NVM_DIR=$HOME/.nvm && . $NVM_DIR/nvm.sh && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm build # -> public/build
boot.env: cp .env.example .env + APP_URL=http://localhost:9049, DB_CONNECTION=sqlite-persistent, DB_DATABASE=/koel/database/koel.sqlite, MEDIA_PATH=/media, YOUTUBE_API_KEY=koel49-dummy-audit-key (ouvre la route youtube ; l'écran reste feature-gated)
boot.run: docker run -d --name koel49 -p 9049:8000 -v ~/work/koel49:/koel -v ~/work/koel49-media:/media koel49-php php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=8000 && docker run --rm -v ~/work/koel49:/koel koel49-php composer install --no-dev && docker exec koel49 php artisan key:generate --force && docker exec koel49 php artisan koel:init -n --no-assets --no-scheduler && docker exec koel49 php artisan config:cache
boot.admin_seed: python3 tools/seed.py http://localhost:9049 ~/work/koel49-media # rejouable : 30 mp3 ffmpeg sine+ID3 (seed-media.sh), koel:scan, 3 playlists (standard x2 + smart Ambient), playlist-folder, favoris, plays, rating album — admin créé par koel:init (User::FIRST_ADMIN_EMAIL)
boot.creds: admin@koel.dev / KoelIsCool (défauts koel:init) — login.mjs récupère le jeton API -> auth.json (localStorage api-token/audio-token JSON-encodés)

audit.baseline: node audit.mjs --urls "$(paste -sd, urls-public.txt)" --out ../reports/baseline-public --states none --wait-for '#app' --wait 2500 http://localhost:9049 && node audit.mjs --urls "$(paste -sd, urls-auth.txt)" --out ../reports/baseline-auth --states none --storage-state auth.json --wait-for '#app nav' --wait 2500 http://localhost:9049 && node audit.mjs --urls "/#/songs" --out ../reports/baseline-states --states all --storage-state auth.json --wait-for '#app nav' --wait 2500 http://localhost:9049
audit.final: mêmes commandes avec --out ../reports/final-{public,auth,states} — exécutées après dernier pnpm build
audit.install_build: tools/install-build.sh : clone vierge ~/work/koel49-install @SHA + git apply --check patch.diff (0 rejet, 83 fichiers) + pnpm install --frozen-lockfile + pnpm build + composer install (conteneur jetable) + koel:init -n --no-assets --no-scheduler + seed rejoué :9048 (KOEL_CONTAINER=koel49-install) + rescan reports/installbuild-{public,auth,states,guarded} : 0 viol/0 err
audit.verify: node verify.mjs http://localhost:9049 auth.json -> 37/37 PASS ; node eval-final.mjs http://localhost:9049 auth.json -> 24/24 PASS ; incomplete-probes sur final-{public,auth,states} -> 0 FAIL (102 N-A + 6 PASS dont link-in-text-block corrigé) ; vanilla -> 16 FAIL nommés (verify-vanilla.txt) + states 12 règles/591 occ/1 err ; sabotage aria-label dialog retiré -> FAIL nommé 'context-menu: dialog nommé'
